nextStoryContext: All 49 test/supervisor/**/*.test.ts files that rooted a temp dir in the OS temp dir are migrated onto createTestTmpdir via scripts/codemod-test-tmpdir.ts (AC1 grep is clean over test/supervisor); this includes the two FIXED pid-based paths (backend-adapter.test.ts:25, codex-adapter.test.ts:171), which the codemod's existing bare-join branch already handled correctly (join(tmpdir(), `prefix-${process.pid}`, '.claude') -> join(createTestTmpdir(), ...)) -- no hand-edit was needed for those two despite the PRD notes flagging them as a possible special case. IMPORTANT FIX this story made to the shared codemod (scripts/codemod-test-tmpdir.ts, used by every remaining migration story US-005..US-007): two new bugs surfaced only once the codemod ran over a subtree with more files than US-003's top-level sweep. (1) pruneUnusedNamedImport used a non-global regex, so a file with TWO separate `from 'node:os'` import statements (e.g. `import { homedir } from 'node:os';` then later `import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';`) only ever checked the first and silently left the second, genuinely-dead import unpruned; fixed by adding the `g` flag and looping exec() until the statement whose captured names actually include the target identifier is found. (2) the usage-check body only stripped import lines and comment lines, so a `describe('gate lifecycle: real tmpdir + async poll loop ...', ...)` title -- a plain quoted STRING LITERAL, not a comment -- still contained the bare word and falsely counted as a live reference, blocking import removal; fixed with a new `stripQuotedStringLiteralContents` helper that blanks single/double-quoted string contents (escape-aware) before the usage regex runs, while deliberately leaving backtick template literals untouched (they can embed a real `${identifier(...)}` usage). Both are regression-pinned in test/codemod-test-tmpdir.test.ts (17 tests now, up from 15). Detection method that caught both bugs: run the codemod, then `bun run typecheck` -- an unpruned dead import surfaces immediately as TS6133 'X is declared but its value is never read', a cheap deterministic backstop that any future migration story should run right after invoking the codemod, before trusting the diff. AC3's oracle (rmSync/MIT count parity vs main, non-vacuity guard) passed cleanly with zero manual file touch-ups beyond the codemod's own output plus the two bugfixes above -- no test file needed a hand-rolled import edit this story. Remaining rooting sites for US-005..US-007 are outside test/supervisor/** and outside top-level test/*.test.ts (already done in US-003); grep test/ (excluding test/supervisor and top-level *.test.ts) for `join(tmpdir()` to find the next front's file list.
